selection_rule: All visual sources with duration <= 360 seconds; fixed before replay

queries.query: Show the OpenRefine opening title card.
queries.review_observation: The opening card is sampled and retains the OpenRefine words/logo in the center crop, although the line starts at the crop edge. Top 1 is a browser/map transition, not the opening card. Static/title ranking regression.

queries.review_observation: The reviewed 70.237-73.740s sequence includes the project table, a loading transition, then many table rows. Top 1 at 262s shows a later add-column expression dialog. Repeated similar screens and broad wording also limit the old interval labels; no alternate intervals are added.

queries.review_observation: The reconciliation dialog is visible throughout 108.233-111.736s. Top 1 shows an earlier import/create-project screen. Text-specific UI semantics remain unsupported by this representation; this is not missing temporal pixels.

queries.query: Find three martial artists on the mat in front of the red and white backdrop.
queries.review_observation: Three active martial artists on the mat before the red/white backdrop are visible at 242.242-245.746s. Top 1 at 166-169s shows only two active artists, one down; requested group count is not met.
